And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Join Ripple in Singapore as a Product Operations Analyst — Customer Activations This role is uniquely positioned to transform customer experiences by seamlessly integrating them into our innovative products. You'll be at the forefront of a global financial revolution, working cross-functionally to ensure flawless activations and world-class customer support.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Manage dormant account processes and ensure human review before deactivation.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • A 'self-starter' mentality with outstanding coordination skills for multi-team, multi-step processes.
  • Strong investigative and problem-solving abilities to trace money and data across systems.
  • High attention to detail, documentation in the field, and comfort in a compliance-sensitive environment.
  • Excellent written communication skills with institutional clients and internal collaborators.
  • Proficiency with CRM (Salesforce) and ticketing (Jira) tools.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

descriptions.job-1lhtnrh:
Company Description

About us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 4 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 150 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets - achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive - starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth - yours, ours, and society’s - you’ll feel right at home.

Job Description

The role

We're looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to own and advance Solflare's organic search strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

We already have a solid SEO foundation in place. Your role won't be to start from scratch, but to build on what's working, identify untapped opportunities, and take our organic visibility to the next level.

You'll work on a large-scale website with potentially millions of indexed or indexable pages, where technical SEO, content strategy, and smart prioritization can have a significant impact.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and getting things done. You'll collaborate directly with experienced colleagues across Marketing, Product, and Engineering, with the autonomy to shape how we approach organic growth.

Core responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve our SEO strategy - Build on our existing foundation, identify growth opportunities, and translate them into a clear, actionable roadmap.
  • Drive organic search performance - Improve rankings, qualified organic traffic, and visibility for Solflare and its products across global markets.
  • Lead technical SEO initiatives - Identify and prioritize opportunities related to crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, and performance across a large-scale website.
  • Optimize for traditional and AI-powered search - Develop approaches to improve Solflare's visibility in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging discovery platforms.
  • Shape our content SEO strategy - Work with content creators and other stakeholders to ensure landing pages, product pages, and editorial content are built around search intent and measurable organic growth opportunities.
  • Strengthen off-page SEO - Identify and execute opportunities to improve domain authority, backlink quality, and competitive positioning.
  • Improve product discoverability - Support organic visibility for Solflare's browser extension and other relevant product discovery channels.
  • Measure what matters - Monitor performance, turn data into actionable insights, and continuously refine priorities based on impact.
  • Collaborate across teams - Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering to turn SEO opportunities into implemented improvements.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a track record of delivering measurable organic growth in competitive markets.
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to SEO strategy, from identifying opportunities to executing and measuring results.
  • Strong understanding of technical SEO, including crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, and large-scale website optimization.
  • Solid experience with on-page SEO, content optimization, off-page SEO, and link-building strategies.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and other SEO analytics and auditing platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI search optimization (AEO) and an interest in how search behavior and discovery are evolving.
  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize initiatives based on potential business impact.
  • Ability to work independently, challenge assumptions, and collaborate effectively.
  • Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in crypto, Web3, fintech, or another highly competitive digital industry.
  • Experience optimizing websites with a large number of dynamically generated pages.
  • Experience with international or multilingual SEO.
  • Knowledge of app store optimization (ASO) or Chrome Web Store discoverability.

Additional Information

Personality traits we value:

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office - up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time - work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few
  • Learn about crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.
descriptions.job-0re8p8t:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

"At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait, VP of Talent, TRM Labs

Once TRM wins a customer, our Post-Sales, Investigations, and Compliance teams are what turn that relationship into real impact. These teams help agencies build cases, help institutions manage risk, and help customers get lasting value from our platform.

As a Post-Sales Recruiter, you’ll own TRM’s most strategic and mission-critical searches across Customer Success, Global Investigations, Compliance, and Revenue Operations while serving as a mentor and force multiplier for the recruiting pod.

The impact you'll have:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for senior and business-critical roles across Customer Success, Global Investigations, Compliance, Revenue Operations, and adjacent GTM/business functions.

  • Act as a strategic talent partner to executive stakeholders; advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, hiring strategy, and close approach.

  • Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional post-sales talent from high-growth technology, fintech, crypto, public sector, and financial services environments.

  • Develop deep market maps for priority searches that include competitive talent, high-performing corporate functions, and referral-driven networks.

  • Create an exceptional candidate experience for senior and specialized talent, so every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles.

  • Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time.

  • Serve as a craft leader on the Talent team, raising the bar for sourcing, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and strategic search execution.

What we're looking for:

  • 5-7+ years of recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, enterprise, or mission-driven environments.

  • 3+ years of experience successfully recruiting experienced Sales professionals across one or more of: public sector, defense, financial institutions, crypto, blockchain, DeFi, fintech, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise SaaS.

  • A strong outbound sourcing muscle: proven ability to identify, engage, nurture, and close passive candidates for competitive, hard-to-fill roles.

  • Experience partnering with senior GTM leaders to define strategy, calibrate profiles, diagnose funnel problems, and drive searches to close.

  • Strong command of pipeline metrics and conversion data, with the ability to spot bottlenecks, adjust quickly, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

  • Comfort operating in a quota-like environment, balancing multiple searches while protecting the highest-impact roles.

  • A persuasive, credible communication style that lands with senior candidates, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Excellent judgment on candidate quality, motivation, risk, and close strategy.

  • Grit, resilience, and a closing mindset: you create momentum rather than wait for inbound interest.

About the team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates.

  • We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.

  • We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.

  • We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.

  • Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review.

  • Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen.

  • Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled.

    Our Onboarding Process:

    • Within your first 30 days, you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions.

    • Within your first 60 days, you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds.

    • Within your first 90 days, you’ll have made 2–3 hires.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - 190,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Sr. Executive Assistant to support senior leadership within the CEO office, including operating within a Co-CEO leadership model. This role provides high-level administrative support and ensures key projects, budgets, travel, and events run seamlessly — managing complex, ever-changing calendars with responsibility for multifaceted coordination. The ideal candidate brings experience or familiarity with communications and executive affairs, enabling them to operate confidently in a fast-paced environment.

The Opportunity

  • Work in lockstep with other EAs within the CEO office, understanding the unique dynamics of a Co-CEO leadership model — sharing information, coordinating responsibilities, and maintaining seamless executive support across leaders.

  • Build relationships with the broader team while acting as a gatekeeper for the executives; anticipate needs and potential issues before they arise, planning for multiple contingencies and implementing solutions with minimal direction.

  • Manage an exceptionally complex and ever-changing executive calendar, balancing competing priorities and making thoughtful decisions on behalf of the CEO; coordinate meetings, handle logistics, manage competing deadlines, and review incoming requests to ensure they're on the Executive's radar with all necessary information.

  • Prepare comprehensive briefing materials for meetings, speaking events, and travel, along with agendas, minutes, and organized records of key projects and initiatives.

  • Coordinate all aspects of domestic and international travel — commercial and private aircraft, ground transportation, accommodations, visas, and customs requirements — and serve as the primary point of contact for private aviation providers, managing flight schedules, passenger manifests, and catering.

  • Monitor travel plans proactively, adjusting logistics in real time to accommodate changing business priorities, weather events, operational delays, or other unforeseen circumstances.

  • Coordinate cross-functional projects and events — including timelines, deliverables, stakeholder engagement, and partnering with events, security, and other teams — while identifying opportunities to streamline processes and enhance executive effectiveness.

  • Track and oversee team tasks, budgets, and meeting schedules to ensure deadlines and deliverables are met, and support onboarding and ramp-up for new team members.

  • Process expense reports, purchase orders, budget reconciliations, and receipts/invoices with accuracy and timeliness, along with additional duties as assigned.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of proven experience as an executive assistant, administrative manager, or similar role supporting senior leadership, ideally within a CEO office or multi-executive leadership structure.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercising discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive information.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting with strong personalities and demanding timeframes.

  • Natural talent for improving processes and bringing order out of chaos, remaining calm during periods of disorganization.

  • Strong sense of urgency when projects are assigned, with the ability to complete tasks quickly while anticipating the next one in short succession.

  • Highly proficient with Google Suite, MS Office Suite, Adobe Suite, MacOS, and generally tech savvy.

  • Familiarity with communications strategies, executive affairs, and leadership environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Flexibility in approach — this business operates across all time zones.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in budget tracking, travel coordination, event planning, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Comfort working across multiple teams, time zones, and with external partners.

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a focus on efficiency.

Our commitment

Own Your Intelligence

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

You will build continual learning systems that turn agent trajectories, corrections, and failures into new tasks and model updates. You will compare streaming RL, batched post-training, and distillation, and determine which improvements belong in model weights or persistent memory, skills, prompts, and subagent state. Your experiments will track skill acquisition, transfer, forgetting, and loss of plasticity over long sequences of tasks.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

Control update cadence, policy lag, task drift, and exploration, and evaluate each checkpoint on earlier skills, unseen tasks, and general capabilities. Build task-generation and training pipelines with reproducible data and harness versions, so regressions can be traced to a specific change and rolled back. You will work directly with the external collaborators whose deployments drive the research.

Representative early problems

  • Select high-value production traces and interventions, convert them into training signal, and establish regression gates before a change reaches deployment.

  • Determine which adaptation belongs in model weights, harness state, memory, tools, or data, then measure the tradeoffs across a sequence of tasks.

  • Build evaluations that distinguish retained learning and transfer from memorization, context accumulation, or measurement drift.

What you will own

  • Methods for selective consolidation, replay, adaptation, memory, and online or offline RL.

  • Evaluations for retention, transfer, regression, and rollback as tasks and distributions change.

  • Promotion gates and human oversight for agents that continue to change in production.

  • Field experiments, benchmarks, and open research that make continual improvement measurable and transferable.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: continual or online learning, RL, meta-learning, memory systems, post-training data loops, adaptive production ML, or evaluation under changing distributions.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

Benefits and Perks

  • Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives

  • Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

  • Visa Sponsorship & relocation support

  • Professional Development budget

  • Team Off-sites & conference attendance

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

Stripe’s comms organization does more than the traditional: we produce films that get shown at festivals, sell over 300,000 books annually, run some of the fastest growing social media channels in tech, write talks and skits for external and internal events attended by thousands of people, build physical machines that track commerce in real-time, create podcasts in pubs, and much more besides. Comms Operations is a small, nimble team serving as the connective tissue between strategy and execution. Our mission is simple: we build and redefine the operating foundations that enable the most creative and ambitious storytelling in the world possible. This is not a traditional operations role, and we’re not looking to introduce heavy processes or to eliminate the unpredictability inherent in comms work. Instead, you’ll have a front-row seat in how the Communications team builds and protects Stripe’s brand and influence across the world – and play a pivotal part in designing the flywheel that compounds that impact.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an exceptional and ambidextrous early-career operator to help us build and scale this infrastructure. You will work across every altitude, from co-designing high-level team planning mechanisms to managing the granular details of a complex project to ensure that it lands successfully. Some weeks, that might mean redesigning processes and building custom AI agents to handle repetitive workflows. Other weeks, it’s gaveling on the best lightning talks to feature during our onsite and pitching a mandatory jingle jam.

Responsibilities 

  • Team systems & infrastructure: Create processes, onboarding resources, and shared playbooks that help the team prioritize, track, and execute work effectively.
  • Workflow automation: Lead the transformation of the team’s critical administrative engines such as inbound media requests, speaking inquiries, and team communication channels and aliases.   • Project and program management: Act as the embedded PgM for complex comms programs (e.g., Stripe Sessions, the Annual Letter) from planning through execution. Translate fast-moving initiatives into clear objectives, plans, milestones, and reporting.

  • Highly organized and able to manage several workstreams without losing attention to detail.

Preferred qualifications
